note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 28 November 2026, RealHunt lists 171 homes for sale in Spain, each one checked by a person.
In Spain, the median asking price of those 171 homes is €125,000 (€1,232 per m², from the 168 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €39,000 and the most expensive €348,000.
Taxes and fees add about 7.5–14% to the price of a home in Spain (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: New build: 10% IVA + 0.5-1.5% AJD stamp duty + notary 0.5-1% + legal 1-2%; resale: ITP transfer tax 6-11% instead of IVA/AJD.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes, no restrictions at present; the government has proposed a 100% tax on (or ban for) non-EU non-resident buyers, not enacted.
buying.annual_property_tax: IBI 0.4-1.1% of cadastral value (municipal), plus imputed income tax on unlet homes.
buying.rental_income_tax: Non-residents: EU/EEA 19% on net income; non-EU 24% on gross with no deductions.

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom cave house with courtyard and terrace in Castilléjar, Granada
homes.title_es: Casa cueva renovada de 3 dormitorios con patio y terraza en Castilléjar, Granada

Inside are a living room with an adjoining room, a kitchen with storage room and two modern bathrooms with walk-in showers. A large enclosed courtyard offers ample parking and room for a terrace or garden, plus an 18-metre cave tunnel for a workshop or studio. Castilléjar is 5 to 10 minutes away by car, and Granada is about 1 hour and 40 minutes away. Asking €129,950, about €928/m².

homes.title_es: Casa de campo de 3 dormitorios con vistas a la montaña, jardín y chimenea en Barinas, Murcia

The living room has a wood-burning fireplace and air conditioning, and the home has exposed wooden beams. Outside there is a garden, a sunny front porch with mountain views, two private rear patios and 3,670 sq ft of land. A separate plot holds a barbecue area, storage room and parking for one car. The village of Barinas is a short walk away, and Abanilla is nearby. Asking €133,500, about €1,151/m².

homes.title_es: Casa cueva lista para entrar a vivir, amueblada, con vistas a la montaña en Freila, Granada

A spacious patio with a BBQ area and parking overlooks the mountains and Andalusian countryside. The house sits on a quiet street on the edge of Freila, with Baza about 15 minutes away and Granada around 1.5 hours by car. The natural insulation keeps temperatures pleasant year-round. Asking €140,000, about €1,037/m².

homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo con piscina privada y terraza cubierta en Monòver, Alicante

It is a 1-minute walk from a restaurant, bodega and car repair garage, and Monòver and Pinoso are both under a 10-minute drive away. Asking €164,995, about €937/m².

homes.title_es: Casa adosada con patio interior, garaje y jardines privados en Cañada de la Leña, Murcia

homes.title_es: Cortijo con piscina, vistas y chimenea en Huércal-Overa, Almería

A private swimming pool sits beside the house on a completely flat, fenced plot with wide views over the landscape. homes.title: Single-storey 3-bedroom detached house with garden and garage in Matanza, León
homes.title_es: Casa independiente de una planta de 3 dormitorios con jardín y garaje en Matanza, León
homes.summary: Built in 1972, this single-storey detached house is in good overall condition. It has 83 m² of built area, 3 bedrooms, a separate fully equipped kitchen with a pantry, and one full bathroom. The private garden includes a small outbuilding and a working well, and the garage has a bar counter and barbecue. The house has individual radiator heating with a fuel-based energy supply, plus fibre-optic internet. The village has a bar, shop, pharmacy and swimming pools. Asking €99,000, about €961/m².

homes.title: 1-bedroom apartment with pool in Torrevieja
homes.title_es: Apartamento de 1 dormitorio con piscina en Torrevieja
homes.summary: €99,900 for 47 m² and 1 bedroom in Torrevieja (Alicante), about €2,126/m². About 1000 m from the sea. With pool and terrace. Ready to move in: listed in very good condition, and not marked as occupied, rented or at auction. Ask for the nota simple before paying a deposit.

homes.title: 2-bedroom house with terrace in San Pedro del Pinatar
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios con terraza en San Pedro del Pinatar

homes.summary: €99,950 for 57 m² and 2 bedrooms in San Pedro del Pinatar (Murcia), about €1,754/m². About 1000 m from the sea. With terrace. Ready to move in: listed in good condition, and not marked as occupied, rented or at auction. Ask for the nota simple before paying a deposit.

homes.title: Fully renovated 3-bedroom house with terrace and views in Algueña, Alicante
homes.title_es: Casa totalmente reformada de 3 dormitorios con terraza y vistas en Algueña, Alicante
homes.summary: This fully renovated house is move-in ready, with a living and dining room featuring a fireplace. There are three double bedrooms, a fully renovated bathroom and a fully equipped kitchen. Outdoors, the home has a terrace with views across the village and towards the mountains, a private patio and 1,356 sq ft of land. New electrical and plumbing systems, an alarm system and an east-facing orientation complete the home. It is set in the village of Algueña in the Valencian countryside. Asking €125,000, about €1,238/m².

homes.title: Fully renovated house with terrace and second residence in Alcaudete de la Jara, Toledo
homes.title_es: Casa totalmente reformada con terraza y segunda vivienda en Alcaudete de la Jara, Toledo
homes.summary: This fully renovated house spreads over two floors and has access from two streets. The ground floor offers a living-dining room, a separate kitchen with pantry, an en-suite bedroom and a full bathroom, plus a second independent residence with two bedrooms and a full bathroom. Outdoor features include a patio, a large upper-level terrace, a storage room and a 171 m² plot. The home has air conditioning and a living area of 198 m². Asking €139,900, about €707/m².

homes.title: Three-bedroom townhouse with two terraces in La Marina, Costa Blanca
homes.title_es: Casa urbana de tres dormitorios con dos terrazas en La Marina, Costa Blanca
homes.summary: A townhouse of 116 m2 in the La Marina urbanisation on the southern Costa Blanca, extended upwards to give three bedrooms and two bathrooms, including an extra-large main bedroom. It faces east for morning sun and is described as ready to move into. The photos show a tiled front terrace with awning, a first-floor balcony, a fitted kitchen with dishwasher, a long living and dining room with air conditioning and a small roof solarium. At about 1,380 euros per m2 it is well below most homes on this stretch of coast. Community fees are not stated in the advert.

homes.title: Restored 1925 village house with beams, fireplace and a private patio
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de 1925 restaurada, con vigas, chimenea y patio privado
homes.summary: A 1925 village house restored in 1995 and kept in perfect condition: exposed wooden beams, a living-dining room with fireplace, an independent kitchen, a suite bedroom with its own bathroom opening onto a private patio, a second bedroom with balcony and an attic room with views of the church tower and the mountains. 118 m², 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms. About an hour west of Madrid.

homes.title: 1920 house on the main square of Corpa with four bedrooms and a terrace
homes.title_es: Casa de 1920 en la plaza mayor de Corpa con cuatro dormitorios y terraza
homes.summary: A 1920 village house in the heart of Corpa, next to the town hall and the 17th-century palace on the main square. 145 m² usable: a large living room, independent kitchen, four bedrooms, two full bathrooms, a terrace and a storage room. 15 km from Alcalá de Henares and 50 km from Madrid.

homes.title: Renovated townhouse with roof solarium and sea views in Torrevieja, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.title_es: Adosado reformado con solárium en la azotea y vistas al mar en Torrevieja, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.summary: Fully renovated south-facing townhouse with 120 m2 of living space over two floors and a rooftop. It has three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a front terrace, a second-floor terrace off the master bedroom and a private roof solarium. It is sold fully furnished and equipped, with views of La Mata salt lake, the natural park and the Mediterranean Sea. Urban bus stops, shops and restaurants are just moments away. Asking €189,000, about €1,575/m².

homes.title: Furnished flat in a garden complex with a big pool, tennis and sea views
homes.title_es: Apartamento amueblado en un complejo ajardinado con gran piscina, tenis y vistas al mar
homes.summary: A furnished one-bedroom flat in a well-kept complex in the Botánico area of Puerto de la Cruz, among palm trees and tropical gardens, with a large pool, a tennis court, a play area, a porter and a lift. The bedroom and living room open onto a balcony with views of the gardens and the sea. Puerto de la Cruz has mild, spring-like weather all year.

homes.title: Fully renovated penthouse with a sunny terrace over the pools
homes.title_es: Ático reformado integralmente con terraza al sol sobre las piscinas
homes.summary: A bright penthouse in Costa del Silencio, a few steps from Montaña Amarilla, fully renovated with quality materials: two double bedrooms, an elegant living-dining room with a modern open kitchen and a new bathroom. Its 12 m² terrace looks over the complex's pools and gardens and the rooftops to the sea. Lift, communal pools.

homes.title: 3-bed duplex with a 227 m² private garden and pool, near Corralejo
homes.title_es: Dúplex de 3 dormitorios con jardín privado de 227 m² y piscina, cerca de Corralejo
homes.summary: A 76 m² duplex in the Origomare estate in Majanicho, a quiet spot by the north coast minutes from Corralejo's beaches, shops and restaurants. Three bedrooms (two on the ground floor), two full bathrooms, a fitted kitchen and a bright living-dining room opening onto a wide terrace and a 227 m² private garden. Communal pool with sea views.

homes.title: Mountain country house with big outdoor space
homes.title_es: Casa de campo en la montaña con mucho espacio exterior
homes.summary: Country house in the mountains Built into the mountainside, this unique property pairs generous outdoor space with charming living areas that embrace the slower rhythm of country life.

homes.title: 1-bedroom apartment in Murcia
homes.title_es: Apartamento de 1 dormitorio en Murcia
homes.summary: €85,000 for 46 m² and 1 bedroom in Murcia (Murcia), about €1,848/m². About 14 km from the coast (straight line). Ready to move in: listed in very good condition, and not marked as occupied, rented or at auction. Ask for the nota simple before paying a deposit.

homes.title: 3-bedroom cave house with views and land in Castilléjar, Granada
homes.title_es: Casa cueva de 3 dormitorios con vistas y terreno en Castilléjar, Granada
homes.summary: This is a cave house in Castilléjar, Granada, with its rounded cave ceilings preserved throughout. It has 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a spacious kitchen and several large rooms for living, sleeping or a home office. A large enclosed area at the front offers parking for several vehicles and views of the surrounding hills, and the plot covers 5,285 sq ft of land. The kitchen has a large traditional fireplace hood. Huéscar is about 15 km away, and Granada Airport is about 139 km away. Asking €95,000, about €913/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom ground-floor flat with garden and mountain views in Anna
homes.title_es: Piso bajo de 2 dormitorios con jardín y vistas a la montaña en Anna
homes.summary: €96,000 for 61 m² and 2 bedrooms in Anna (Valencia), about €1,574/m². About 38 km from the coast (straight line). With mountain views. Ready to move in: listed in good condition, and not marked as occupied, rented or at auction. Ask for the nota simple before paying a deposit.

homes.title: Flat with sea views in Roses
homes.title_es: Piso con vistas al mar en Roses
homes.summary: €97,000 for 47 m² in Roses (Girona), about €2,064/m². About 2 km from the coast (straight line). With sea view. Ready to move in: listed as almost new, and not marked as occupied, rented or at auction. Ask for the nota simple before paying a deposit.

homes.title: 2-bedroom apartment with mountain views in Garrucha
homes.title_es: Apartamento de 2 dormitorios con vistas a la montaña en Garrucha
homes.summary: €98,000 for 59 m² and 2 bedrooms in Garrucha (Almería), about €1,661/m². About 700 m from the sea. With mountain views and patio. Ready to move in: listed in good condition, and not marked as occupied, rented or at auction. Ask for the nota simple before paying a deposit.

homes.title: Renovated house with beams and terrace in Hondón de los Frailes, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.title_es: Casa reformada con vigas de madera y terraza en Hondón de los Frailes, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.place: Hondón de los Frailes, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.summary: Carefully renovated village house with high ceilings and wooden beams kept throughout. The ground floor has a bright living room, an equipped kitchen, a dining room with a fireplace, a bedroom, a bathroom and a private patio. Upstairs, a hallway with wooden beams leads to two more bedrooms and a bathroom. The structure and exterior are in good condition, and bars, restaurants, supermarkets, a pharmacy and a medical centre are a short walk away. Asking €129,950, about €1,300/m².

homes.title: Renovated, furnished studio in Golf del Sur with pool and gardens
homes.title_es: Estudio reformado y amueblado en Golf del Sur con piscina y jardines
homes.summary: A bright 53 m² studio in Golf del Sur, renovated and sold furnished: an open living and sleeping space with a sofa bed, built-in wardrobes, a fully equipped open kitchen, a full bathroom and a balcony terrace. The private estate has large gardens, a communal pool, a restaurant and a supermarket, with the golf courses and the seafront promenade nearby.

homes.title: 134 m² flat a few steps from Chinchón's famous Plaza Mayor
homes.title_es: Piso de 134 m² a pocos pasos de la famosa Plaza Mayor de Chinchón
homes.summary: A bright, fully exterior first-floor flat of 134 m² a few metres from the Plaza Mayor of Chinchón, one of the prettiest towns near Madrid: living room with big windows, independent kitchen with pantry, a very large main bedroom with dressing area, a separate office and a full bathroom. Cross ventilation. Sold furnished.

homes.title: Forest house with a 45 m² terrace, hot tub and fireplace
homes.title_es: Casa en el bosque con terraza de 45 m², jacuzzi y chimenea
homes.summary: A terraced house surrounded by forest, 500 metres from Sant Pere Sacarrera in Mediona, about an hour from Barcelona: a bright 29 m² dining room with open kitchen and fireplace opening onto a 45 m² terrace with hot tub, 3 bedrooms and a garden. Quiet enough to live in all year.

homes.title: Two-level beach flat in Antigua Bay, freshly done up, with pool and sea views
homes.title_es: Apartamento de playa en dos plantas en Antigua Bay, recién renovado, con piscina y vistas al mar
homes.summary: A two-level flat in the Antigua Bay complex in Caleta de Fuste, with two bedrooms, a full bathroom with a stone-tiled walk-in shower, a bright living room and a modern kitchen, air conditioning and furniture included. The complex has a large pool and lawn looking out to the sea, and the sandy beach of Caleta de Fuste is a short walk away. 15 minutes from Fuerteventura airport.

homes.title: 2-bed flat between Jávea and Moraira with lagoon pools, 700 m from the cove
homes.title_es: Piso de 2 dormitorios entre Jávea y Moraira con piscinas tipo laguna, a 700 m de la cala
homes.summary: An 85 m² flat in Cumbre del Sol, Benitachell, between Jávea and Moraira, with open views over the Moraira valley: two bedrooms, a bright living-dining room with an open kitchen, a 15 m² partly covered terrace, air conditioning, heating and a parking space. Built in 2007, in good condition. Two lagoon-style pools, big gardens and a social club; the Cala Llebeig cove is 700 m away.

homes.title: Renovated beachfront bungalow with a corner terrace and fireplace
homes.title_es: Bungalow reformado en primera línea de playa con terraza en esquina y chimenea
homes.summary: A just-renovated corner bungalow on the front line of L'Almadrava beach in Els Poblets, next to Dénia: 80 m² over two floors, a big corner terrace partly covered with an awning, a fireplace, an open kitchen to the living-dining room, two double bedrooms (one with a balcony), two shower rooms and air conditioning upstairs and down. Communal pool and gardens, outdoor parking, sold furnished.

homes.title: 2-bedroom flat with patio in Manresa
homes.title_es: Piso de 2 dormitorios con patio en Manresa
homes.summary: €61,990 for 55 m² and 2 bedrooms in Manresa (Barcelona), about €1,127/m². With patio. Ready to move in: listed as renovated, and not marked as occupied, rented or at auction. Ask for the nota simple before paying a deposit.

homes.title_es: Piso de 2 dormitorios con terraza en Bejís
homes.summary: €65,000 for 69 m² and 2 bedrooms in Bejís (Castellón), about €942/m². With terrace. Ready to move in: listed as renovated, and not marked as occupied, rented or at auction. Ask for the nota simple before paying a deposit.

homes.title: 3-bedroom flat with mountain views in Reinosa
homes.title_es: Piso de 3 dormitorios con vistas a la montaña en Reinosa
homes.summary: €85,000 for 80 m² and 3 bedrooms in Reinosa (Cantabria), about €1,062/m². With mountain views. Ready to move in: listed as renovated, and not marked as occupied, rented or at auction. Ask for the nota simple before paying a deposit.

homes.title: Renovated 2-bedroom house with rooftop terrace and views in Galera, Granada
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de 2 dormitorios con azotea y vistas en Galera, Granada
homes.summary: The house has been fully renovated and modernized, with a new kitchen and two bathrooms across two floors. It offers 82 m2 of living space with 2 bedrooms and a self-contained ground-floor studio with its own kitchen and bathroom. Outdoor space includes a fenced terrace and a rooftop terrace of about 6 x 6 meters with views over the village and surrounding mountains. A storage room/garage for one car sits next to the house. Huéscar is 15 minutes away and Baza about 30 minutes. Asking €95,000, about €1,159/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom house in Benamargosa
homes.title_es: Casa de 2 dormitorios en Benamargosa
homes.summary: €95,995 for 56 m² and 2 bedrooms in Benamargosa (Málaga), about €1,714/m². About 13 km from the coast (straight line). Ready to move in: listed in very good condition, and not marked as occupied, rented or at auction. Ask for the nota simple before paying a deposit.

homes.title: Studio with communal pool 950 m from La Mata beach, Torrevieja
homes.title_es: Estudio con piscina comunitaria a 950 m de la playa de La Mata, Torrevieja
homes.summary: A bright 29 m² studio in the Torresol 2 gated complex, with an enclosed balcony, fitted kitchen and appliances, communal pool and gardens. About 950 m on foot to La Mata beach. Running costs are low, about €518 a year in total. Asking €99,000.

homes.title: 1-bedroom house with terrace in Torrevieja
homes.title_es: Casa de 1 dormitorio con terraza en Torrevieja
homes.summary: €99,900 for 48 m² and 1 bedroom in Torrevieja (Alicante), about €2,081/m². About 4 km from the coast (straight line). With terrace. Ready to move in: listed as renovated, and not marked as occupied, rented or at auction. Ask for the nota simple before paying a deposit.

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom house with terrace and fireplace in Jijona, Alicante, Valencian Community
homes.title_es: Casa reformada de 3 dormitorios con terraza y chimenea en Jijona, Alicante, Comunidad Valenciana
homes.summary: Renovated house in the old town of Jijona, spread across several floors. It has three bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, and a separate kitchen on the main floor. Each floor has its own lockable door, and the third floor includes an independent space. The upper floor has a terrace, and the house also has a fireplace, with about 96 m² of built area. The property is close to shops, restaurants and public services. Asking €119,500, about €1,245/m².

homes.title: Turnkey furnished 1-bedroom house with garden and pool in El Ronquillo, Seville
homes.title_es: Casa amueblada lista para entrar a vivir de 1 dormitorio con jardín y piscina en El Ronquillo, Sevilla
homes.summary: Built in 2010, the 66 m² house spans two floors and is in excellent condition, ready to move into or to adapt. It has one bedroom and one bathroom, air conditioning and a fireplace. The home is sold fully furnished with sofa, beds, fridge and barbecue, and includes a private garden and a balcony. Residents share a swimming pool for adults and children and a padel court inside a gated community. Asking €125,000, about €1,894/m².

homes.title: Modern 3-bedroom townhouse with terrace and pellet heating in Casas del Señor, Alicante
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de 3 dormitorios con terraza y estufa de pellets en Casas del Señor, Alicante
homes.summary: The townhouse has 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 100 m2 of living area, with double-glazed windows in the living room. Each room has air conditioning, and a pellet cooker provides heating in the colder months. The terrace has a mini bar, and the property includes 807 sq ft of land. The best restaurants in the area are a 5 minute walk away. Monóvar and Pinoso, with all amenities, are about 7 minutes away, and Alicante airport and beaches are around 40 minutes. Asking €149,000, about €1,490/m².

homes.title: Renovated townhouse with fireplace and mountain views in Cortes de la Frontera, Málaga
homes.title_es: Casa adosada reformada con chimenea y vistas a la montaña en Cortes de la Frontera, Málaga
homes.summary: The townhouse was carefully restored in 2003 and keeps its original stone walls and wood beams. It has 114 m2 of living space over three floors, with three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a living-dining room with a fireplace and a kitchen with patio access. The second-floor bedroom opens onto a roof terrace with panoramic mountain views. Shops and services are within walking distance, and the historic city of Ronda is 30 km away. Asking €170,000, about €1,491/m².

homes.title: Charming renovated flat by Parque Taoro with its own street entrance
homes.title_es: Apartamento con encanto reformado junto al Parque Taoro, con entrada propia desde la calle
homes.summary: A cosy flat in San Fernando, one of the nicest parts of Puerto de la Cruz, next to Parque Taoro and a 10-minute walk from Lago Martiánez, shops and restaurants. It has two entrances, one straight from the street and one through the building. A large bedroom with a separate dressing room, a newly renovated bathroom and a bright open living room and kitchen. Communal pool, sold furnished.

homes.title: Designer-renovated flat with a big shaded terrace in Costa del Silencio
homes.title_es: Apartamento reformado con diseño y gran terraza con toldo en Costa del Silencio
homes.summary: A first-floor flat in the Frontera-Primavera complex in Costa del Silencio, south Tenerife, finished with wood panelling and a vertical garden: living room with an equipped open kitchen and air conditioning, a separate bedroom, a bathroom with shower and a large terrace with an awning. Communal pool and gardens. Sold furnished. Tenerife South airport is 10 minutes away.

homes.title: Bright 2-bed flat with open views and a palm-fringed pool in Cumbre del Sol
homes.title_es: Piso luminoso de 2 dormitorios con vistas abiertas y piscina con palmeras en Cumbre del Sol
homes.summary: A bright flat in Cumbre del Sol, Benitachell, with open, clear views over the hills: two large double bedrooms with built-in wardrobes, a full bathroom, a cosy living-dining room with a fully equipped open kitchen and split air conditioning, and a 15 m² terrace. Lift, communal pool among palms and gardens. Jávea and Moraira are 10 minutes away.

homes.title: 2-bedroom bungalow with private garden and terrace in Orihuela, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.title_es: Bungalow de 2 dormitorios con jardín privado y terraza en Orihuela, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.summary: Ground-floor bungalow built in 2008, in good condition. It offers 90 m² of built area, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and an open-plan living room with kitchen. Private garden of about 100 m², 10 m² covered terrace and 190 m² plot, with hot and cold air conditioning. Sold furnished with an equipped kitchen, plus a storage room and a garage space. Communal pool, green areas and children's play area in the residential complex. Asking €198,000, about €2,200/m².

homes.title: Renovated furnished 2-bedroom bungalow with terrace in Orihuela, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.title_es: Bungaló reformado y amueblado de 2 dormitorios con terraza en Orihuela, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.summary: Fully renovated and furnished ground-floor bungalow, ready to move into. It has 2 bedrooms with fitted wardrobes, a modern bathroom with a walk-in shower, and a fully fitted kitchen with a washing machine and dishwasher. Outside there is a front porch with awnings, a spacious terrace overlooking a communal garden, and an external storage room. Shopping centres, supermarkets, golf courses and La Zenia Boulevard are within walking distance, and the beaches of Orihuela Costa are a short distance away. Asking €199,000, about €2,341/m².

homes.title: Wooden 1-bedroom house with terrace, views and land in Lorca, Murcia
homes.title_es: Casa de madera de 1 dormitorio con terraza, vistas y terreno en Lorca, Murcia
homes.summary: This wooden house offers 99 m² of living space, one bedroom and one bathroom. It includes a fully equipped kitchen, separate living and dining rooms, and an enclosed veranda with a terrace. The 4.5 hectares of land offer panoramic views from every corner. The home has solar panels, butane gas heating and a current water connection to the neighbouring property. It is 10 minutes from El Consejero and 25 minutes from Lorca centre. Asking €127,000, about €1,283/m².

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom bungalow with terraces and solarium in Torrevieja, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.title_es: Bungalow renovado de 3 dormitorios con terrazas y solárium en Torrevieja, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.summary: Fully renovated and furnished single-storey bungalow with 3 bedrooms and 1 bathroom with walk-in shower and separate toilet. The bright living room has air conditioning and the open-plan kitchen is fully equipped. Outdoor space includes 2 terraces and a large private solarium with outdoor furniture, with room for a jacuzzi. Solar panels with inverter are already installed, and 2 bicycles and beach equipment are included. The beach and Torrevieja town centre are 2 km away, in the La Torreta II area. Asking €140,000, about €2,333/m².

homes.title: Modern 2009 duplex in the mountains of the Sierra Oeste, ready to move in
homes.title_es: Dúplex moderno de 2009 en plena sierra oeste, para entrar a vivir
homes.place: Robledondo, Santa María de la Alameda, Madrid
homes.summary: A spotless duplex in a 2009 building in Robledondo, a mountain village of the Sierra Oeste de Madrid surrounded by nature: a bright living-dining room with large windows downstairs, and two bedrooms and two full bathrooms (one en suite) upstairs, with open views of the countryside. 96 m².

homes.title: Two-bedroom corner duplex with mountain-view terrace in Alcalá de la Selva
homes.title_es: Dúplex de esquina de dos dormitorios con terraza con vistas a las montañas en Alcalá de la Selva
homes.summary: A corner duplex built in 2009 in Alcalá de la Selva, a mountain village in Teruel about 10 minutes from the Valdelinares ski slopes and an hour from Valencia. It has 112 m2 built, 95 m2 usable, with two bedrooms with fitted wardrobes, a bathroom with bath, a guest toilet, a fitted kitchen and a living room with a fireplace insert. The east-facing terrace has wide views of the pine-covered hills. A lift, a covered parking space and a storage room are included. The photos show a modern, well-kept interior, ready to move into. Community fees are not stated in the advert.

homes.title: Townhouse with terraces and garden in Elche, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.title_es: Casa adosada con terrazas y jardín en Elche, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.summary: This townhouse is in very good condition and has no overlooking neighbours. It offers a large living room, an open-plan kitchen, two bedrooms with built-in wardrobes and one bathroom. Air conditioning is fitted in the living room and the master bedroom. Several terraces catch sun or shade at different times of day, and well-maintained trees surround the house, including palms and olive trees. It sits in a residential area 3 km from La Marina beaches and has a carport for one vehicle. Asking €179,000, about €2,887/m².

homes.title: Townhouse with heated pool and stairlift in Playa Flamenca, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.title_es: Adosado con piscina climatizada y salvaescaleras en Playa Flamenca, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.summary: Ready to move into, this townhouse offers 85 m2 of built area across three double bedrooms, two full bathrooms and a guest toilet. A stairlift serves the upper floor, and there is a separate outdoor laundry area. The private, gated complex has a communal heated pool and recreational areas for use throughout the year. The home is in Playa Flamenca, about 1,600 metres from the Mediterranean beaches and a few minutes from Zenia Boulevard shopping centre. Asking €187,700, about €2,208/m².

homes.title: Top-floor two-bedroom flat with private roof terrace in Cabo Blanco, Tenerife
homes.title_es: Piso de dos dormitorios en la última planta con terraza privada en la azotea en Cabo Blanco, Tenerife
homes.summary: A bright 82 m2 flat on the top floor of a small block in Cabo Blanco, a local Canarian town about 10 minutes by car from the TF-1 and the south coast resorts of Los Cristianos. Open-plan living room and modern kitchen, two good bedrooms with built-in wardrobes, a bathroom with walk-in shower and a utility room. The best part is a private roof terrace behind its own gate, furnished with loungers and a table, with mountain views. Sold furnished and described as turnkey, with a supermarket, shops and bars close by. Community fees are not stated.

homes.title: Bright renovated three-bedroom flat with modern kitchen in Bellavista, Sevilla
homes.title_es: Piso de tres dormitorios luminoso y reformado con cocina moderna en Bellavista, Sevilla
homes.summary: Fully renovated in 2025 with excellent natural light throughout. Open-plan modern kitchen with fitted appliances and patterned backsplash. Three spacious bedrooms plus one bathroom in a second-floor interior/exterior unit.

homes.title: Corralejo flat with a sunny terrace over three pools and palm gardens
homes.title_es: Apartamento en Corralejo con terraza al sol sobre tres piscinas y jardines con palmeras
homes.summary: A bright upper-floor flat in one of Corralejo's most wanted areas, in a quiet, well-kept complex with 24-hour security. One double bedroom, a bathroom with walk-in shower and a living room with an equipped kitchen. Its private terrace looks straight over the three communal pools and the palm gardens.

homes.title: 3-bedroom house with underbuild and solar panels in Benejúzar, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.title_es: Casa de 3 dormitorios con bajo construido y placas solares en Benejúzar, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.summary: The house has three bedrooms, a renovated bathroom and an open-plan living area with a wood-burning stove. A spacious underbuild adds extra rooms, a home office, storage and an additional toilet. Six solar panels with battery storage, double-glazed windows, private parking and a garden shed are included, with access to a nearby communal swimming pool. The property is within walking distance of Vistabella Golf and about 20 minutes' drive from the Costa Blanca beaches. Asking €205,000, about €2,330/m².

homes.title: Two-bedroom duplex with private garden and shared pool in Costa de Antigua
homes.title_es: Dúplex de dos dormitorios con jardín privado y piscina compartida en Costa de Antigua
homes.summary: A two-floor home of about 61 m2 in the Los Soles complex on the east coast of Fuerteventura, a few minutes from Caleta de Fuste and its beaches. Downstairs is a bright living room with an open modern kitchen and a guest toilet, upstairs two bedrooms and a full bathroom. The private rear terrace garden opens towards the communal pool, which the advert says was recently renovated and has showers and toilets. Described as in excellent condition and ready to move into. Community fees are not stated in the advert, so ask before making an offer.

homes.title: Move-in-ready 3-bedroom townhouse with terrace in Torrevieja, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.title_es: Adosado de 3 dormitorios listo para entrar a vivir con terraza en Torrevieja, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.summary: This ready-to-move-in townhouse offers 103 m2 of living space across three bedrooms and two full bathrooms. A spacious terrace provides outdoor space for enjoying the Mediterranean climate. It sits in the quiet Los Balcones area of Torrevieja, with bus stops nearby. Mercadona supermarket and Torrevieja Hospital are close by, and the nearby tennis club offers a swimming pool, gym and hard tracks for a monthly membership of 60 euros. Asking €194,900, about €1,892/m².

homes.title: Tastefully renovated flat steps from Montaña Amarilla
homes.title_es: Apartamento reformado con mucho gusto a pocos pasos de Montaña Amarilla
homes.summary: A flat in the Chasna complex in Costa del Silencio, renovated in 2025 with real taste: a large bedroom plus a smaller second room, a bright living room, and a new kitchen and bathroom. A few steps from Montaña Amarilla, the volcanic cove where people dive, swim and walk the coastal paths. One of the sunniest corners of Tenerife.

homes.title: 1-bedroom country house in Biar
homes.title_es: Casa de campo de 1 dormitorio en Biar
homes.summary: €85,000 for 63 m² and 1 bedroom in Biar (Alicante), about €1,349/m². Ready to move in: listed in good condition, and not marked as occupied, rented or at auction. Ask for the nota simple before paying a deposit.

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom townhouse with garden and storeroom in Torrevieja, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.title_es: Adosado reformado de 3 dormitorios con jardín y trastero en Torrevieja, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.summary: This 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom townhouse in Los Balcones, Torrevieja, offers 91 m2 of living space. All three bedrooms and the family bathroom have been fully renovated. It has a front garden and a sunny rear garden for outdoor dining. A large storeroom provides space for bicycles, suitcases and outdoor furniture. The plot measures 1,432 sq ft of land. Asking €194,950, about €2,142/m².

homes.title: One-bedroom flat with a sunny terrace, shared pool and sea views in Almuñécar
homes.title_es: Apartamento de un dormitorio con terraza soleada, piscina compartida y vistas al mar en Almuñécar
homes.summary: A 45 m² flat in Los Pinos, a hillside residential area of Almuñécar on the Costa Tropical, in a small white complex of only five homes. One bedroom, one bathroom, an open kitchen behind a brick arch and a living room with air conditioning that opens onto a wide tiled terrace. A few steps away are the shared pool and a covered barbecue area, both looking straight out over the Mediterranean and the coast. Terracotta floors, sold empty and clean. The price has been cut by about 10% to €149,000. Community fees are not stated in the advert.

homes.title: Flat renovated less than a year ago in central Aranjuez
homes.title_es: Piso reformado hace menos de un año en el centro de Aranjuez
homes.summary: Exterior, bright two-bedroom flat in a central street of Aranjuez, renovated less than a year ago: open living room with wooden ceiling, new kitchen, fitted wardrobes and air conditioning. 60 m². Shops and services on the doorstep, and the royal palace and gardens close by.

homes.title: Renovated 2-bedroom rural house with fireplace, garden and land in Prado Negro, Granada
homes.title_es: Casa rural reformada de 2 dormitorios con chimenea, jardín y terreno en Prado Negro, Granada
homes.summary: The renovated rural house keeps its rustic character and has two bedrooms, one bathroom, a living room with a fireplace, a dining room and a kitchen across 60 m². It faces south, so it gets plenty of natural light, and has a private garden and sits on more than 13,000 m² of private land. A photovoltaic installation, alarms, video surveillance and a reinforced door are included. The village is about 30 minutes from Granada, and the house is sold with furniture. Asking €165,000, about €2,750/m².

homes.title: New 2025 detached house on a 1,500 m² flat plot near the San Juan reservoir
homes.title_es: Chalet independiente nuevo de 2025 en parcela llana de 1.500 m² cerca del pantano de San Juan
homes.summary: Detached house built in 2025 and barely used, in the Costa de Madrid estate of San Martín de Valdeiglesias. About 70 m²: open living room with a kitchen island and large windows to the garden, a big suite bedroom with walk-in shower and a guest toilet. Heat-pump heating. The flat 1,500 m² plot has room for a pool. Low running costs.

homes.title: Renovated top-floor flat facing the ocean and Teide in Mesa del Mar, Tenerife
homes.title_es: Piso de última planta renovado frente al océano y el Teide en Mesa del Mar, Tenerife
homes.summary: A one-bedroom flat on the tenth and top floor of a seafront building in Mesa del Mar on the north coast of Tenerife, next to the beach and natural sea pools. The photos show open ocean from the windows and Mount Teide from the bedroom. The advert says plumbing, wiring, bathroom and kitchen were recently renewed, and it is sold furnished. Lift access. The building is having its paintwork redone; the owner has already paid that charge. The communal pool is closed with no reopening date given. About 51 m2. Monthly community fees are not stated.

homes.title: Move-in-ready 3-bedroom townhouse with garage and pool in Orihuela, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.title_es: Adosado de 3 dormitorios con garaje y piscina en Orihuela, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.summary: The townhouse is in very good condition and ready to move into without renovation, having been carefully maintained by its owners. It spreads over three floors, with a living-dining room, open-plan kitchen and guest toilet on the ground floor. Two bedrooms with built-in wardrobes and their own balconies sit on the first floor, while the third bedroom with en-suite bathroom opens onto a private terrace upstairs. A private garage connects directly to the house, and the portal lists a swimming pool and garden. Asking €215,000, about €2,688/m².

homes.title: 1-bedroom country house with fireplace in O Saviñao
homes.title_es: Casa de campo de 1 dormitorio con chimenea en O Saviñao
homes.summary: €80,000 for 50 m² and 1 bedroom in O Saviñao (Lugo), about €1,600/m². With fireplace. Ready to move in: listed as almost new, and not marked as occupied, rented or at auction. Ask for the nota simple before paying a deposit.

homes.title: Townhouse with rooftop solarium, jacuzzi and courtyard in Tolox, Málaga
homes.title_es: Casa adosada con solárium en la azotea, jacuzzi y patio en Tolox, Málaga
homes.summary: The townhouse has 60 m2 of living space with two double bedrooms and one family bathroom, all finished to a high standard. The bright living area has an open-plan kitchen with direct access to a 40 m2 private courtyard, shaded by a mature grapevine and with a BBQ area. A staircase leads from the courtyard to a 60 m2 roof solarium with a Jacuzzi included and mountain views to the front and back. The property is listed unfurnished. Asking €149,000, about €2,483/m².

homes.title: Renovated village house with its own pool in Benijófar, Costa Blanca
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo renovada con piscina propia en Benijófar, Costa Blanca
homes.summary: A single-storey house in the centre of Benijófar, a small town in the Vega Baja inland from the southern Costa Blanca, renovated and described as move-in ready. About 66 m2, south facing, with an open living room and kitchen, two double bedrooms with high ceilings and wooden beams, and a modern shower room. The private walled yard holds a pool of about 18 m2 and a dining terrace, which is rare at this price. Shops, schools and health services are in the town. Community fees and yearly tax are not stated in the advert.

homes.title: Townhouse with communal pools and private terrace in Cabo Roig, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.title_es: Casa adosada con piscinas comunitarias y terraza privada en Cabo Roig, Costa Blanca, Alicante
homes.summary: This west-facing townhouse has two double bedrooms, a family bathroom with underfloor heating and a ground-floor guest toilet. The living room has a separate dining area, and the spacious kitchen includes a utility area. A glazed front terrace and a private outdoor terrace provide space for dining or relaxing. Residents have access to four communal swimming pools and well-maintained gardens within a private development on the outskirts of Cabo Roig. The living area is 75 m2 on a plot of 1,076 sq ft. Asking €209,995, about €2,800/m².

homes.title: Bright duplex apartment with exposed brick in central Madrid
homes.title_es: Amplio duplex con ladrillo visto en el centro de Madrid
homes.summary: Two-bedroom duplex in the vibrant Embajadores-Lavapiés neighbourhood, just 0.9 km from the city centre. Split-level design with high ceilings, industrial steel beams, and authentic exposed brick walls throughout. Original character well-preserved with modern finishes; ground floor placement provides direct street access.
